if not currentValue.value: return
	
	#Create functions that will add or update this widget to the database tables.
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	widgetInfo = self.view.custom.widgetInfo

	# Save the widget
	if widgetId:

		system.perspective.print('updateWidget returned %s %s'%(success, msg))
	else:
		widgetId, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.addWidget(widgetInfo, userId)
		self.params.value.widgetId = widgetId
		system.perspective.print('addWidget returned %s %s'%(widgetId, msg))
	
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	params = self.custom.widgetInfo.params
	widgetParamList = []
	for param in params:
		if not param['widgetParameterName']: continue
		widgetParameterId = param['widgetParameterId']
		if widgetParameterId:
			retVal, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.updateWidgetParameter(param, userId)
		else: 
			param['widgetId'] = widgetId
			widgetParameterId, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.addWidgetParameter(param, userId)
		
		widgetParamList.append(widgetParameterId)

#	system.perspective.print("widgetParamList %s"%widgetParamList)

	#If user has deleted parameters, we'll remove them from the database
	widgetParams = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.dashboard.getWidgetParameters({'widgetId': widgetId}))
	for widgetParam in widgetParams:
		if widgetParam['widgetParameterId'] not in widgetParamList:
			system.kanoa.dashboard.deleteWidgetParameter(widgetParam['widgetParameterId'], userId)

	import time
	time.sleep(0.5)

	self.refreshBinding("custom.widgetInfo")	
	self.refreshBinding("custom.widgetInfo.params")
	self.custom.devOPS.updateDBRecord = False	
	
	return

customMethods.name: saveWidget
customMethods.script:
userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	widgetInfo = self.view.custom.widgetInfo
	widgetId = widgetInfo['widgetId']
	
	if widgetId: 	# Save the widget
		success, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.updateWidget(widgetInfo, userId)
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.widgetInfo")
	else:
		if system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('widgetId', system.kanoa.dashboard.getWidgets({'widgetName': widgetInfo['widgetName'], 'widgetCategoryName': widgetInfo['widgetCategoryName']})) is not None:
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', 'A widget with this name already exists in this category. Please choose another name or category for this widget.')
			return
			
		widgetId, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.addWidget(widgetInfo, userId)
		self.view.params.value.widgetId = widgetId

	if msg:	system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', msg)
	else:
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.widgets")
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Widget parameter has been saved')
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('widgetsUpdated', {})	#Inform the dashboard editor that a widget has been added or updated
	
	return widgetId, msg

customMethods.name: validateViewParams
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print('validateViewParams() called with')
	
	viewParams = self.view.custom.widgetInfo.viewParams
	
	try:	
		viewParams.replace('null', 'None')
		viewParams.replace('true', 'True')
		viewParams.replace('false', 'False')
		
		viewParams = system.util.jsonDecode(viewParams)
		system.perspective.print("viewParams are %s"%viewParams)
		
		for k,v in viewParams.items():
			system.perspective.print("%s: %s"%(k,v))
			
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'viewParams are valid')
	except:
		msg = 'viewParams are invalid'
		system.perspective.print(msg)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', msg)
		viewParams = None
	
	return viewParams

customMethods.name: exportWidget
customMethods.script:
"""
	Used to export a widget.
	"""
	
	widgetId = self.view.custom.widgetInfo.widgetId
	widgetName = self.view.custom.widgetInfo.widgetName
	data, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.exportWidget(widgetId)
	
	document = system.util.jsonEncode({'exportType': 'widgetInfo', 'data': system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(data))})
	
	now = system.date.format(system.date.now(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')
	fileName = '%s Widget - %s.json'%(widgetName, now)
	
	system.perspective.download(fileName, document, 'text/json')
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'The current widget was exported.'})
